title: Quick Irish Lamb Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful lamb dish inspired by traditional Irish cuisine. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt and pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, garlic, and rosemary. Add the lamb and toss to coat.
In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove the bacon and set aside.
Add the lamb to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Bragg's Apple Cider Vinegar and stir to combine.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 2-3 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb and vegetables hot, garnished with fresh rosemary and crispy bacon.
